src/components/common/.description: Common components directory contains reusable UI components like LoadingSpinner, ScreenHeader, and TraktLoadingSpinner. New EmptyState component should follow the same patterns (useTheme hook, size props, StyleSheet).

src/components/common/EmptyState.tsx.description: Reusable EmptyState component with flexible props for icon (MaterialIcons, Ionicons, MaterialCommunityIcons), title, subtitle, and primary/secondary action buttons. Uses useTheme hook and has tablet responsiveness at 768px breakpoint.

src/components/common/index.ts.description: Barrel export file for common components. Enables cleaner imports like `import { EmptyState, LoadingSpinner, ScreenHeader } from '../components/common'` instead of individual file imports.

src/screens/SearchScreen.tsx.description: SearchScreen has two empty state scenarios: (1) 'Keep typing...' when query is exactly 1 character, (2) 'No results found' when search completed but no results. Both now use EmptyState component with MaterialIcons (search and search-off icons).

src/screens/LibraryScreen.tsx.description: LibraryScreen has three empty state scenarios: (1) 'No Trakt collections' when traktFolders.length === 0, (2) 'No content in {folderName}' when a specific folder is empty, (3) 'No movies/TV shows/content yet' when filteredItems.length === 0 based on filter. All now use EmptyState component with MaterialCommunityIcons (folder-off-outline, folder-open-outline) and MaterialIcons (video-library).

src/screens/PluginsScreen.tsx.description: PluginsScreen has two empty state scenarios in the "Available Plugins" collapsible section: (1) 'No Scrapers Found' when searchQuery has value but no matching results, (2) 'No Scrapers Available' when filteredScrapers.length === 0 and no search query. Both now use EmptyState component with Ionicons (search and download-outline icons).

src/screens/DownloadsScreen.tsx.description: DownloadsScreen has two empty state scenarios: (1) 'No Downloads Yet' when downloads.length === 0, uses EmptyState with 'download-outline' icon from MaterialCommunityIcons and 'Explore Content' action navigating to Search. (2) 'No {filter} downloads' when filter returns no results (ListEmptyComponent), uses EmptyState with 'filter-off' icon from MaterialCommunityIcons with custom emptyFilterState style (flex: 0, paddingVertical).

src/screens/CalendarScreen.tsx.description: CalendarScreen has two empty state scenarios: (1) 'No episodes for {date}' when selectedDate is set but filteredEpisodes.length === 0 (uses event-busy icon size 48 with Show All Episodes action), (2) 'No upcoming episodes found' when calendarData.length === 0 (uses calendar-today icon with subtitle). Both now use EmptyState component with MaterialIcons library.
